attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page says only that the holy Donagos, bishop of Libya, was martyred by fire. The corpus holds no other Donagos in any spelling, and no bishop of Libya. No century and no year are given, so there is no `dates` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
